name: Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_sup
statement: Type*} [CommRing R] {p I J : Ideal R} [p.IsPrime] (hle : I ≤ p) (h : p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ∈ (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).minimalPrimes) : p ∈ (I ⊔ J).minimalPrimes

name: Ideal.map_sup_mem_minimalPrimes_of_map_quotientMk_mem_minimalPrimes
statement: Ideal R} {P : Ideal S} [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p] (hI : p ∈ I.minimalPrimes) {J : Ideal S} (hJP : J ≤ P) (hJ : P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) ∈ (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S)))).minimalPrimes) : P ∈ (I.map (algebraMap R S) ⊔ J).minimalPrimes
